approved_meaning: Independent FX replay forward-fills only within the configured positive finite calendar-gap limit after the verifier rejects nonpositive or nonfinite limits.
FX prices may bridge only a configured positive integer calendar-gap limit; normalization rejects noninteger boolean or negative limits and zero skips forward filling before this call.
Price cleaning may bridge only the caller-supplied positive integer gap limit; runtime validation rejects missing noninteger boolean zero or negative limits before this call.
